title: Absolute random-subset Fourier average
statement: For a natural number $n$, a real parameter $\delta$, a real-valued function $f$ on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, and a subset $S$ of the coordinate indices, define the average over random subsets $K$ with parameter $1-\delta$ of $|\widehat f(S\cap K)|$, where $\widehat f$ denotes the Fourier coefficient of $f$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
$S$ is a finite set of coordinate indices
